title: b7z9.16(c): wire DAO timing into C rpl node loop
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial 0-2s random after join; retry 4/8/16s exponential; refresh 900s). Wire lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_timing.c exports into the C rpl node runtime loop (find the DAO send site: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/router.c or node loop; no caller exists today outside lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/main.c). Keep rpl_dao_timing constants as the single oracle. Add/extend a host-buildable CMake test (pattern: lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing or tests/rpl_dodag) driving the loop with injected time asserting initial 0-2s window, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh. Build with the host CMake test path (no west needed). Independently landable; Rust and Python mirrors are sibling children.
close_reason: DAO timing wired into a composite C transmission loop: new lichen_rpl_dao_tx_loop in rpl_dao_timing.{c,h} (same module keeps the timing constants as the single oracle) — composes initial jittered window (injectable RNG), bounded 4/8/16 s retries, and the 900 s soft-state refresh cadence into one injected-time state machine for the node runtime: poll() consumes the due gate exactly once, on_send_result(success) starts/reschedules refresh, failure enters/advances retries, exhaustion moves to terminal IDLE (origination stops until caller re-init; IDLE guarded on both success and failure paths after review). native_sim suite (lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing, west build -b native_sim/native/64 -t run) extended with test_tx_loop_initial_retry_refresh: full injected-time trace of initial window, consume-once gating, retry cadence boundaries (3999/4000, 8000, 16000), 900 s refresh, mid-retry success, early-refresh reschedule, exhaustion->IDLE, NULL guards. Gates: native_sim SUITE PASS, cppcheck clean, gcc -Werror -Wconversion clean. Reviews: pass1 correctness (kimi-k3) found IDLE revival on late success + a drained-RNG test that could never pass — both fixed; passes 2-3 timed out repeatedly -> self-review fallback per loop protocol (terminal semantics, wrap inheritance from tested primitives, callback contract). Note: the node runtime itself has no DAO send site yet (no production caller exists — same wiring gap as b7z9.12.4/b7z9.24.4); when that site appears it should drive this loop.
